# A file open in Libertty that grows past 5 MB (a log being written) is no
# longer read again at each change, and the page says so. The editor keeps
# its text, unsaved changes too; a save asks before writing over the file,
# and the file is followed again once it's what the editor wrote.
# (Made here, so a second attempt starts as the first did.)
shell:rm -rf @DIR@ && mkdir -p @DIR@ && printf 'first line\n' > @DIR@/app.log && printf '# Log\n\nStarted.\n' > @DIR@/notes.md
edit:@DIR@/app.log
editor-wait:go
expect-editor:first line
shell:printf 'second line\n' >> @DIR@/app.log
wait:0.5
expect-editor:second line
editor-insert:mine-
expect-dirty:yes
shell:head -c 6000000 /dev/zero | tr '\0' x >> @DIR@/app.log
wait:1.0
expect-page:grew past 5 MB
expect-dirty:yes
expect-editor:mine-
page-js:libertty.text().length < 1000 ==> true
shell:printf 'more\n' >> @DIR@/app.log
wait:0.5
page-js:libertty.text().includes('more') ==> false
key:cmd+s
wait:0.6
expect-sheet-text:changed on disk
sheet:Overwrite
expect-file:@DIR@/app.log=mine-
expect-shell:test $(wc -c < @DIR@/app.log) -lt 1000 && echo small ==> small
expect-dirty:no
expect-page-not:grew past 5 MB
shell:printf 'after\n' >> @DIR@/app.log
wait:0.8
expect-editor:after
# A page (Markdown shown rendered) the same: it stays as it was, saying why.
open:@DIR@/notes.md
page-wait:go
expect-page:Started.
shell:printf 'Then more.\n' >> @DIR@/notes.md
expect-page:Then more.
shell:head -c 6000000 /dev/zero | tr '\0' x >> @DIR@/notes.md
wait:1.5
expect-page:grew past 5 MB
expect-page:Then more.
shell:printf 'Later on.\n' >> @DIR@/notes.md
wait:0.8
expect-page-not:Later on.
expect-page:grew past 5 MB
